data.one_liner: A bottom drawer widget supporting custom headers, bodies, list bodies, and drag gestures.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable bottom drawer widget for Flutter that supports drag-to-open and drag-to-close interactions. It allows custom header and body content as well as list bodies, controlled via a dedicated controller.
use_when: You need a bottom drawer widget with custom header and body layouts.
You want support for drag-to-open and drag-to-close drawer interactions.
avoid_when: You require complex navigation integration with bottom sheets.
You need advanced platform-specific modal bottom sheet implementations.
strengths: Supports custom drawer header and body.
Supports drag to open and close functionality.
Includes a controller to easily open and close the drawer programmatically.
weaknesses: Limited documentation and advanced customization options.
Relies on manual height configurations like headerHeight and drawerHeight.
